Setup lab: tools and robot

WPILib, Game Tools, roboRIO, radios and SPARK MAX

WPILib 2026 · Java · Command-based

Setup

What has to be done

1

Install WPILib

Each laptop.

2

Install the FRC Game Tools

Each laptop.

3

Image the roboRIO

4

Program the radios

Both radios.

5

Set up the motor controllers

Every SPARK MAX.

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

2

Job 1: install WPILib

Get the WPILib installer

1

Download the Windows .iso

Version 2026.2.1, from the link or the install USB stick.

2

Right-click it and choose Mount

3

Run WPILibInstaller.exe

If Windows warns you, click More info, then Run anyway.

WPILib install guide

docs.wpilib.org: WPILib Installation Guide

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

3

Job 1: install WPILib

Run the WPILib installer

1

Press Start, then choose Everything

2

Choose Install for this User

3

Choose Download for this computer only

From a USB stick, choose Select existing VS Code archive.

4

Press Finish, then open 2026 WPILib VS Code

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

4

Job 2: install Game Tools

Install the FRC Game Tools

1

Find FRC Game Tools 2026 on the NI site

Log in with an NI account.

2

Click Download

From a USB stick, mount the .iso and run install.exe.

3

Click Yes and Next through the screens

Accept the license. On Fast Startup, change nothing and click Next.

4

Reboot if asked

Then find FRC Driver Station on the desktop.

Game Tools install guide

docs.wpilib.org: Installing the FRC Game Tools

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

5

Job 3: image the roboRIO

Find out which roboRIO you have

Look for a microSD card slot.

No card slot: roboRIO 1

Use the next slide, and skip the one after.

Card slot: roboRIO 2

Skip the next slide.

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

6

Job 3: image the roboRIO

Image a roboRIO 1

1

Robot on, then connect the USB cable

The printer-style cable goes in the USB Device port.

2

Open the roboRIO Imaging Tool

Nothing found? Try Run as Administrator.

3

Click Format Target

Enter your team number, pick the latest image, click Reformat.

4

Wait for it to finish

Click OK, then Close.

5

Press the Reset button

roboRIO 1 imaging

docs.wpilib.org: Imaging your roboRIO 1

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

7

Job 3: image the roboRIO

Image a roboRIO 2

1

Find the image file

In the Imaging Tool, click the SD button. Use the newest FRC_roboRIO2 zip.

2

Put the card in a USB reader on your laptop

A card of 2 GB or more is recommended.

3

Write it with balenaEtcher or Raspberry Pi Imager

If Windows offers to format the card, say no.

4

Power off, insert the card, power on

5

Set the team number

Imaging Tool: Edit Startup Settings, Team Number, Apply.

roboRIO 2 imaging

docs.wpilib.org: Imaging your roboRIO 2

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

8

Job 4: program the radios

Connect to the radio

1

Plug Ethernet into the port marked DS

The other end goes in your laptop.

2

Power the radio

Use the PoE adapter or 12 V.

3

Turn off your laptop’s Wi-Fi

4

Open http://radio.local/

Will not load? Run the Vivid-Hosting Network Assistant Tool.

VH-109 quick start

Vivid-Hosting: Quick Start Guide

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

9

Job 4: program the radios

Update the radio firmware

1

Get firmware 2.0.1

Radios on 1.2.x or newer use the file with FROM_1_2_X in its name.

2

Paste its SHA-256 key into the Checksum box

3

Click Upload

Keep the power on until it finishes.

4

Wait for the PWR light to go solid

The SYS light then blinks slowly.

5

Repeat on the second radio

Radio firmware

Vivid-Hosting: Firmware Releases

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

10

Job 4: program the radios

Set up the two radios

1

First radio: choose Robot Radio Mode

Enter your team number and 6 GHz key, then click Configure.

2

Second radio: choose Access Point Mode

Use the same team number and key.

3

Power the access point from the wall

Not from a battery.

4

Write down the 6 GHz key

Keep it with the robot.

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

11

Job 5: set up the motor controllers

Update a SPARK MAX

1

Install REV Hardware Client 2

Not the old REV Hardware Client.

2

Turn the robot off

3

Plug USB into one SPARK MAX

4

Update the firmware

Pick the newest 26.x, even if a newer version is listed.

REV Hardware Client 2

docs.revrobotics.com: REV Hardware Client 2

Setup lab · Install and robot setup

12

Job 5: set up the motor controllers

Give each SPARK MAX its settings

1

Give it a CAN ID from 1 to 63

Every SPARK MAX gets a different ID.

2

Set the motor type

Brushed for CIM, REV NEO Brushless for NEO. Brushed mode can ruin a NEO.

3

Click Persist Parameters

4

Label it and write down its ID, then do the next one

5

Check that they all show up

Power on, USB in any one, then look under CAN Bus.
